_what: One lane's rows for the all-lane in-flight board. Written ONLY by this lane; merged, never edited, by inflight_board.merge_board().
note: 12 of 12 (arm, seed) co-folds are in S3. % DONE is a COUNT of models that exist; the ETA is refused until 3 arrival intervals have been measured (selcal_board.MIN_RATE_INTERVALS) and is a LOWER BOUND whenever an arm has not started, because no measurable interval includes the MSA + model load an arm pays once.

rows.name: selcal_smarca2 co-fold
rows.usd_per_ns: — no ns: co-fold is inference, not MD
rows.why: all 6 seeds have a co-fold in S3. 6/6 seeds; no $/ns is quoted because a co-fold integrates no dynamics — there is no ns denominator, and the lane's MD legs carry a real $/ns from inflight_usd_per_ns.
